candidates.name: SnowUI Design System
text_preview:
SnowUI is a design system and UI Kit created with Figma.
It supports multi-terminal responses for desktop, tablet and mobile devices, and is suitable for developing various types of applications.

candidates.name: Frame
text_preview:
Colors are a key part of the design system.
To define Colors, we have the following principles: 1. Widely used in design. 2. The number of Colors should be as small as possible.
The color in SnowUI has two parts, the color in the Themes variable and the Color styles. Their difference is: when switching between light and dark mode, the color in the Themes variable will change, but the color in the Color styles will remain unchanged.

candidates.name: Frame
text_preview:
Please try to keep the number of Colors below 32.
90% principle: If the color used in a single product accounts for less than 10%, please do not include it in the design system.

candidates.name: About me

Now I'm building SnowUI and trying to make it the best design system possible.
